text:
tablet_felix: Highly inconsistent. Day 16 showed kitchen_table_k1 at 08:02, then coffee_table_l1 at 11:25. Day 17 14:35 feedback confirmed coffee_table_l1, contradicting my guess of nightstand_b1. It swaps spots frequently between living and kitchen. Do not rely on a single location; check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day/afternoon and kitchen_table_k1 for early morning.

mug_felix: Moves between living and kitchen. Check kitchen_table_k1 for early morning, coffee_table_l1 for other times.

charger_felix: Inconsistent. Previous note to check nightstand_b1 was wrong. Day 15 feedback showed coffee_table_l1. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day locations.

book_felix: Inconsistent. I repeatedly guessed nightstand_b1 on Day 16 (12:43, 14:34) but it was at coffee_table_l1 both times. The object stays in the living room during the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day and afternoon locations.

razor_felix: Inconsistent. Day 16 07:00 feedback showed bathroom_shelf_ba1, contradicting my guess of sink_ba_ba1. It moves between shelf, cabinet, and sink. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first in the morning, as it was there today.

glass_felix: Inconsistent. Day 12 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, but Day 13 22:10 feedback showed nightstand_b1. It moves to the bedroom at night. Check nightstand_b1 for late-night locations.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Day 16 19:10 feedback showed kitchen_table_k1, contradicting my guess of coffee_table_l1. It moves between living and kitchen. Check kitchen_table_k1 for evening locations, as it was there today.
